description: Search individual sights across all cities or within one city, by free text, category, interests, historical period, indoor/outdoor, visit length, free entry or distance from a point. Example: five Byzantine sights in Istanbul, Gothic churches in Spain, or free things to do in Rome. Returns name, description, coordinates, visit minutes and page URL for each match.

city_id.description: Gingerguide city id, e.g. "rome" or "istanbul" (from search_cities).

free_only.description: Only sights that are free to enter (squares, parks, free churches). Needs visit info, which some cities do not have yet.

language.description: Language of names and descriptions: en, es, fr, de, tr or zh.

periods.description: Historical periods to favour, e.g. ["byzantine"] or ["roman","renaissance"].

setting.description: indoor suits rainy or hot days.

name: search_attractions
title: Search attractions
